address: 30-31 Albert Place, Edinburgh, EH7 5HN, United Kingdom
bio: With its friendly service and bright monochrome décor, there is a pleasantly relaxed feel to this neighbourhood restaurant and wine bar. The kitchen team take plenty of care in preparing a set menu of fresh-tasting dishes, with desserts proving a highlight – if you're lucky, you'll get to try the wonderfully indulgent tirami-choux. Dietary requirements are well catered for, with well thought out vegetarian and vegan menus available on request....
